page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. The page number and running head sit at the top. The section number XVIII and a reference to "Pearf. pag. 117." stand in the left margin beside the second paragraph. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: tâ Origenis scribit Hieronymum has Homilias excusare tanquam ab Origene admodùm juvene enatas, quoniam parùm elaboratæ sunt, & nonnullis etiam damnatis erroribus infperfæ. Labbeus Iefuita Origenis opera recenfens de Script. Eccl. hæc habet de Homiliis iftis p.144. Tom.2. Homiliæ 39. in Evangelium S. Lucæ, cum Prologo S. Hieronymi interpretis, qui ab ad-modùm juvene scriptas asserit. NON DESUNT QVI AMBIGANT,

XVIII.Firmiora tamen pro Origene Argumen-ta & pro Interprete Hieronymo adversus Pearf. pag. 117.Latinum Authorem sibi suppetere asserit Vindiciarum Auctor, & ne vanum putes promissorem, en tibi quæ ei suppetunt argumenta; S. Hieronymus in Catalogo inter Opera à se edita, in Lucam Homilia triginta novem recitat; Homilias autem ipse nunquam scripsit. In Prologo ad Paulam & Eustochium ostendit se eas ex Origene transtulisse; Hunc Hieronymi Prologum totum in suam Invectivam transcripsit Ruffinus, satis severè exagitavit, & quid in hoc Opere infidè transtulerit ostendit aut innuit: Hæc sunt firmiora Viri docti argumenta, sed fortè minùs firma apparebunt, cùm ea singillatim expenderimus; age igitur incipiamus ab eo quod Hieronymus in Catalogo inter Ope-

page.notes: Section number XVIII and the reference "Pearf. pag. 117." are marginal notes. The word "Homilia" in the italic line "in Lucam Homilia triginta novem" has a ligature-like final letter that could be "Homiliæ"; read as "Homilia". The "s" forms are plain s. Circumflex on "tâ" at the top is as printed. Printed hyphens kept at line ends ("ad-modùm", "Argumen-ta", "Ori-gene" and "Ope-"). The italic quotation runs into the paragraph and is not a heading. Nothing else printed on the page was left out.
